verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents user-directed destruction of physical mail: unwanted mail is shredded on-site and destruction certificates are available. Users can also ask that mail not be opened or scanned, which limits what digital data is created in the first place. Nothing covers retention policies or deleting scanned PDFs and stored records, and the pack actually stresses 'unlimited cloud storage'. Missing for 10: documented controls to delete scanned/digital mail and account data, configurable retention periods, programmatic (API) deletion, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
